subject: Mutual Action Plan & Close Timeline — MAP: VPC peering, API keys, org setup
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@orioncloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Map & POC environment steps for evaluation

Hi Olga / Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team found the latency profile and cost controls compelling. We'd like to move to a short evaluation (POC) focused on our secure inference use case. To keep procurement and security happy, we need a concrete Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that covers the environment setup steps so we can sign off:

- Org & account setup (who creates the org, required IAM roles)
- API keys / service account scoping for the POC
- IP allowlist and port requirements for control plane / egress
- VPC peering approach and networking contacts
- Target close timeline (we're aiming to complete POC by end of September)

Can you put together a draft MAP with owners and realistic lead times? Also include any artifacts you need (peering diagram, contact emails, minimal firewall rules). I'll loop in our infra lead (Samantha) once we have the tech asks.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Integrations
Orion Cloud Health
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@orioncloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Map & POC environment steps for evaluation

Hi Alex — appreciate the clear asks. I've drafted a compact MAP for the POC and attached a one-page summary (orion-map-v1.pdf). High-level proposals and owners below; please reply with owner names/contacts on your side and any constraints:

1) Org & account setup (owner: Orion / owner on our side: Olga) —
   - Option A: Orion creates a customer org in our console; Redwood provides onboarding role ARN for admin. (~1 business day after info exchange)
   - Option B: Redwood creates a trial org and we hand over admin access; useful if you want us to pre-configure routing/policies. (~2 business days)

2) API keys & service accounts (owner: Redwood infra / Vivek) —
   - We'll issue scoped API keys for the POC plus a read-only monitoring key. Keys will be rotated automatically; for the POC we will keep 30-day expiry.
   - Required info: org id, preferred key name, and an email for billing notifications.

3) IP allowlist & firewall (owner: Orion infra / owner on our side: Grace) —
   - Provide a list of egress IPs (we'll provide our control-plane endpoints and peering ranges)
   - Minimal ports: 443 outbound to our endpoints; peered subnets for KV / cache traffic.

4) VPC peering (owner: Orion infra + Redwood infra) —
   - We'll share a peering diagram (attached) and a template peering request with route table entries.
   - Typical turn-around: 3–7 business days depending on your change window.

Proposed timeline to hit a Sep 30 POC end date:
- Week 1 (this week): Confirm contacts + choose org setup option
- Week 2: Create org, issue keys, start IP allowlist work
- Week 3: Complete VPC peering & validation, run sample inference tests
- Week 4: Collect metrics, validate cost/latency targets, brief execs

I'll wait for your infra contact and preferred org flow. If helpful, I can open the peering request on your behalf if you provide the ticket number.

Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: orion-map-v1.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Technical checklist for Orion POC (VPC/API)

Internal notes / checklist (feel free to paste into the MAP):

- VPC peering specifics:
  * Need Orion VPC ID + region + account/project number.
  * Peering mode: cross-account peering (GCP) or VPC peering (AWS) — confirm provider.
  * Required route table changes: add routes for 10.20.0.0/16 -> redwood peering CIDR; ensure no overlapping CIDRs.
  * NAT/egress: ensure our control-plane callbacks are allowed to your egress IPs; recommend a small egress pool for auditability.

- Firewall / ports:
  * Control plane: outbound 443 to api.redwoodinference.com (TLS).
  * Peer data plane: allow ports 2200/2210 for cache/replication (we can tunnel over TLS if customer blocks non-443).

- API keys / service accounts:
  * Create a service account for the POC with an identifier (e.g., orion-poc-svc). We'll issue two keys: admin-scoped key for setup (rotate after 7 days) and runtime-scoped key used by your app.
  * Key length + HSM: default keys are symmetric; if Orion requires HSM signing, we need a SOC/compliance call.

- Test plan:
  * Smoke tests: token round-trip, KV cache warmup, sample inference with 512 tokens.
  * Latency targets: p95 < 200ms for 512 token requests in our hosted region.

- Docs to send: peering template, sample security questionnaire answers.

I'll prepare the peering diagram (orion-vpc-peering-diagram.png) and a short tech checklist to attach.

-Vivek
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@orioncloud.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha@orioncloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Map & POC environment steps for evaluation — Final MAP + next steps

Alex / Samantha — following up with a consolidated Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a concrete near-term schedule. Please review and reply "ack" with the named owner for each line item so we can lock dates.

Summary of owners & deliverables (short):
- Confirm org flow + provide org id (Owner: Alex / Orion) — Due: 2026-09-16
- Provide Orion infra contact + peering ticket if already opened (Owner: Samantha) — Due: 2026-09-16
- Redwood to issue POC API keys & service account (Owner: Redwood / Vivek) — Due: 2026-09-18
- Orion to add Redwood control-plane IPs to allowlist (Owner: Orion infra) — Due: 2026-09-20
- VPC peering complete + routing validated (Owner: joint) — Target: 2026-09-24
- Smoke tests & perf validation (Owner: Redwood) — Target: 2026-09-27
- Executive review & POC decision (Owner: Orion) — Target: 2026-09-30

Attachments included: orion-map-v1.pdf (MAP with owners and timelines), orion-vpc-peering-diagram.png (network diagram + route table template). Also linking the draft MAP doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MapDraftOrion (internal link).

Quick asks for you to reply with:
1) Who will be the named Orion infra owner and an email?
2) Do you prefer Option A (you create org) or Option B (we create trial org)?
3) Any blackout windows for peering changes the week of Sep 20?

Quote: "If helpful, I can open the peering request on your behalf if you provide the ticket number." — if you want us to do that, please send the ticket id and the contact we should copy.

Thanks — once we have the confirmations I will create the HubSpot record and move to SOW/PO discussions if we hit the dates.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
